controlled_corpus.filename: scopus_export_bio-inspiration AND ( framework OR evaluation ) AND construction 8(1).xlsx
controlled_corpus.rule: Only papers present in this controlled corpus are eligible for substantive bio-inspired review analysis.

research_questions.RQ1: What sustainability assessment method/tool is directly implemented by the focal authors?
research_questions.RQ2: What specific inputs are supplied to that method/tool, and where do those inputs originate?
research_questions.RQ3: What engineering/functional performance metrics are measured, calculated, simulated, or tested?
research_questions.RQ4: What sustainability outcomes are generated, in which dimensions, and what specific indicators/values are reported?
research_questions.RQ5: Which engineering-performance metrics actually become tool inputs, through what transformation, and with what resulting sustainability outcome?

calibration_paper.title: Bio-inspired sustainability assessment for building product development - Concept and case study

latest_evidence_rigor.confirmed_linkage: L2: intended building-physical function -> BiSA social-function component

linkage_states.L2: engineering input/modifier directly affects sustainability assessment
linkage_states.L3: integrated engineering+sustainability evidence explicitly drives a decision

critical_errors_to_avoid: Treating legacy workbook coding as focal evidence
Treating engineering numeric results as sustainability outputs
Treating S-LCA as implemented in BIO58 without focal evidence
Using outside web evidence against the closed-corpus rule without explicit authorization
Changing scientific rules to fit a presentation/template
Importing the earlier top-10 corpus or prior scores into the bio-inspired review
next_actions: Admit and hash the exact BIO58 focal PDF if available
Close exact PDF page locators for retained BIO58 claims
Anchor or definitively fail to locate a direct numeric focal sustainability output for BIO58
Re-run BIO58 M/KLM disposition without using engineering metrics as sustainability output
Use the unchanged Version 1.0 schema on contrasting calibration papers such as BIO55 and a facade/building-performance case
Run protocol stability test before scaling to the full controlled corpus
Derive synthesis matrices only from frozen evidence records
